name: tokeneconomizer-codebuddy
description: CodeBuddy CLI adaptation of TokenEconomizer: micro-skills (short repository facts learned from earlier sessions) injected at session start, and a guard that redirects a turn stuck in a failing loop. Tool pruning is not enabled on this host (no verified deny-rule interface). All learned state is namespaced under the codebuddy host, isolated from Claude Code.

author.name: TokenEconomizer authors; CodeBuddy adaptation by timesky
